L13·N4208unmasked layer
This neuron is essentially a document-start detector: it takes its extreme value on the `<|begin_of_text|>` token and stays high across the first handful of tokens of a passage, then flattens out to baseline on ordinary mid-document tokens (sub-word fragments like " FS", "gr", " w", " t").
